mapper.select: /* AlpineNonMemberDao.selectNonMemberList */ SELECT b.USER_NO AS USER_NO, b.USER_NM AS USER_NM, b.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM, b.DUTY_NM AS DUTY_NM, b.PHONE AS phone, b.PW AS pw, b.AUTH AS AUTH, b.USE_YN AS USE_YN, b.LOGIN_DDTM AS LOGIN_DDTM, b.FIRST_LOGIN AS FIRST_LOGIN, h.EVENT_NM AS EVENT_NM FROM AP_USER b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT X.USER_NO, GROUP_CONCAT(X.EVENT_NM ORDER BY X.EVENT_NO DESC SEPARATOR '/') AS EVENT_NM FROM ( SELECT USER_NO, EVENT_NO, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(EVENT_NM) > 11 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(EVENT_NM, 11), '..') ELSE EVENT_NM END AS EVENT_NM FROM ( SELECT B.USER_NO, A.EVENT_NO, CONCAT(A.EVENT_NO, '차 ', A.EVENT_NM) AS EVENT_NM FROM AP_EVENT A LEFT JOIN AP_HISTORY B ON A.EVENT_NO = B.EVENT_NO ) H ) X WHERE X.USER_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY X.USER_NO ) h ON b.USER_NO = h.USER_NO WHERE b.MEMBER_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CASE TRIM(b.DUTY_NM) WHEN '사장' THEN 10 WHEN '전무' THEN 20 WHEN '상무' THEN 30 WHEN '상무보' THEN 40 WHEN '이사' THEN 50 WHEN '부장이사' THEN 60 WHEN '부장' THEN 70 WHEN '차장' THEN 80 WHEN '과장' THEN 90 WHEN '대리' THEN 100 WHEN '기성' THEN 110 WHEN '기장' THEN 120 WHEN '계장' THEN 130 WHEN '주임' THEN 140 WHEN '사원' THEN 150 ELSE 990 END, b.USER_NO ASC
